properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-07: a root cause run from a hub investigates ONE design. The served root-cause skill never mentions a hub, another design, a member or upstream, and every bone it walks names a single-design tool. The /hub skill routes the skill to the one design the fact belongs in, so routing (where to RECORD) decides where to LOOK, and a cause in a design the symptom depends on is never generated as a candidate
properties.statement:
Anthony asked, 2026-10-07, dev_reflow2 hub: "When I do root-cause at the hub level, does the agent just look at one project (the one that it thinks the issue may most likely reside in)? In a system of systems or a system with multiple sub-systems/components, an issue in one project may have downstream affects in other projects or a small fault in one design may be compounded in another project that is dependent/interfaces with another project. If we just look across one design only, may miss these type of failures."

MEASURED on reflow2 main (e72900df5):
- getting-started/skills/root-cause/SKILL.md (16,544 bytes) contains no mention of a hub, another design, a sibling, a member design, upstream, across designs, arriving_from, continue_in or boundary_crossings.
- Its bones name single-design tools only: search_design, seam_report, propagate_from, reconcile_artifacts, coverage_report, evidence_report, detect_defects, invalidated_findings, choices_in_doubt and granularity_report, each answered inside the one design served.
- getting-started/skills/hub/SKILL.md section 5: "Run the skill the fact calls for (brainstorm, capture-intent, root-cause, jot) against the" design the fact belongs in. Choosing where a FINDING is recorded thereby chooses where the INVESTIGATION looks.
- The one cross-design habit, searching precedent in every design the hub reaches, lives in a single agent's private memory (a 2026-09-29 lesson from a flo2.io failure whose mechanism sat in reflow2's design). It is not in any served skill, so another person's agent never meets it.

WHAT IS MISSED, in Anthony's two shapes:
(1) The cause sits upstream and the symptom shows downstream. A supplier design changed an interface, or a part's fault surfaces in the parent or in a peer that uses it.
(2) A small fault compounds across an interface: a tolerance, budget or timing contribution that is within limits in each design and over them in the whole.

WHAT NOW EXISTS TO LOOK ACROSS WITH, unused by root-cause:
- upstream_status: which member designs moved since this design last looked, i.e. the Change bone across designs.
- each member's relation and interfaces (slice 1).
- continue_in and arriving_from (slice 2), which follow impact across members and can be read backwards to ask which members' changes reach the failing node.
- mirrored interfaces and seam_report, the Contract bone at the seam.
- budget_report and constraint composition, for the compounding case inside one design only.
- req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks: precedent in every member (accepted, planned).
